Chirag Ghosh
Senior Product Designer | Bengaluru
chirag.ghosh207@example.com | +91 9693611505

Experienced product designer focused on end-to-end digital experiences for mobile and web platforms. I combine user research with scalable design systems to deliver measurable product improvements and faster delivery cycles. Available with a 15 days notice period.

Experience

Bluefin Logistics — May 2024 - Present
Senior Product Designer (Remote)
- Led creation and governance of a Design Systems library in Figma, reducing UI development rework by 30% and cutting variance across 6 product teams; documented components and usage in Confluence.
- Built high-fidelity Prototyping flows for last-mile tracking features, validating routing and ETA interactions with a 75-user unmoderated test and iterating to improve task completion time by 22%.
- Partnered with product and engineering to define KPIs; translated requirements into reusable components and responsive patterns that improved cross-platform consistency and sped up sprint delivery by 18%.

CartNest — Mar 2021 - Apr 2024
Product Designer (Hybrid)
- Led end-to-end UI/UX Design for multi-vendor checkout flows, increasing conversion rate by 12% and reducing cart abandonment by 8% after A/B testing new interactions.
- Rapid Prototyping in Figma enabled 3-week validation cycles; prototypes were used in stakeholder demos and usability tests with 120 participants to prioritize feature scope.
- Implemented a lightweight Design Systems inventory and documented components and interaction guidelines in Confluence, improving designer-to-engineer handoff and reducing implementation issues by 25%.

Ola — Aug 2019 - Feb 2021
UI/UX Designer (On-site)
- Contributed to company-wide Design Systems, standardizing mobile components which decreased new screen build time by 20% across rides and payments teams; maintained component specs in Confluence.
- Conducted User Research sessions and moderated usability tests for onboarding and driver app flows, synthesizing insights that led to a 15% improvement in task success and clearer in-app guidance.
- Created wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma to validate navigation and microinteraction changes, leading to prioritized roadmap items and measurable UX improvements.

Projects
- RouteViz (personal): Rapid prototype of a route visualization widget using Figma prototypes to test multi-stop UX with 50+ participants; informed reusable patterns later incorporated into work projects.
- Onboarding Flow Redesign: Led a side project to map onboarding funnels, produce low- to high-fidelity prototypes, and measure uplift via moderated tests.

Skills
Tools: Figma, Confluence
Design: UI/UX Design, Prototyping, Design Systems
Research: User Research
